nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI workflow triggered on push to main and on pull requests; uses Nx Cloud distributed task execution to run format check, lint, test, build, typecheck, and e2e across the monorepo.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Nx Cloud distributed execution (nx start-ci-run --distribute-on) to parallelize monorepo tasks across agents, with nx fix-ci as an always-run self-healing step.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Primary CI job on ubuntu-latest that checks out the repo, bootstraps Nx Cloud distribution, installs dependencies with npm ci, and runs format:check followed by lint, test, build, typecheck, and e2e-ci targets via nx run-many.
